name: Oracle
source:
An elderly, but kind old lady. She dilligently watches over the crew as though they were her own children. She seems to have an uncanny knack for perceiving things before they happen, hence the name. Lately, something's been troubling her, however...

[from [url=http://starwish.auriplane.net/?Characters]official site[/url]]
